detailed_descriptions.en: A city builder focused on the fun part: building roads and solving traffic problems! Build a realistic road network Powerful but easy-to-use road tools give you precise control over the layout of your city. Place down road grids at any angle in three clicks, add individual lanes along the side of an existing road, or build overpasses, roundabouts, and traffic lights with ease. Configure protected left turns, adjust traffic light phases and tweak lane connections to fix traffic hotspots. Deep traffic simulation Your creations are stress tested against a smart agent-based microscopic traffic simulation. Cars prefer the fastest route, factoring in traffic. They pull into slip lanes and out to avoid queues into junctions. They do their best to get in lane in time to make a turning. Realistic road hierarchy and interchange design emerges naturally from the properties of the simulation. A simple city economy We kept just enough city economics to give rise to meaningful traffic challenges. Residents need access to shops and workplaces, and hate industrial pollution and road noise. Factories need workers and raw materials. Shops need customers and things to sell. Each time your city levels up you get a batch of buildings to place. The road network must grow! A never ending supply of maps Four biomes, each with a unique playstyle, three difficulty levels, including a sandboxy Chill Mode, and a procedural map generator means you never run out of city to build. Original soundtrack The game comes with a relaxed, upbeat original soundtrack, recorded in a studio by Max and Ruby Jones.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A city builder focused on the fun part: building roads and solving traffic problems!

Build a realistic road network

Powerful but easy-to-use road tools give you precise control over the layout of your city. Place down road grids at any angle in three clicks, add individual lanes along the side of an existing road, or build overpasses, roundabouts, and traffic lights with ease. Configure protected left turns, adjust traffic light phases and tweak lane connections to fix traffic hotspots.

Deep traffic simulation

Your creations are stress tested against a smart agent-based microscopic traffic simulation. Cars prefer the fastest route, factoring in traffic. They pull into slip lanes and out to avoid queues into junctions. They do their best to get in lane in time to make a turning. Realistic road hierarchy and interchange design emerges naturally from the properties of the simulation.

A simple city economy

We kept just enough city economics to give rise to meaningful traffic challenges. Residents need access to shops and workplaces, and hate industrial pollution and road noise. Factories need workers and raw materials. Shops need customers and things to sell. Each time your city levels up you get a batch of buildings to place. The road network must grow!

A never ending supply of maps

Four biomes, each with a unique playstyle, three difficulty levels, including a sandboxy Chill Mode, and a procedural map generator means you never run out of city to build.

Original soundtrack

The game comes with a relaxed, upbeat original soundtrack, recorded in a studio by Max and Ruby Jones.
